notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup (trial key) + inbound demo request. CSM not assigned (SMB).

Key pain: frequent 429s during promotional email blasts; internal frontend queues saturate and client teams see spikes of concurrent API calls when new campaigns land.

From call (2026-03-03 with Maya + Eng lead Jonah):
- "We want a hosted solution but can't have our app return 429s during peak waves — it's killing conversion."
- Typical workload: user-initiated chat and autoreply generation, peak concurrency ~120 rps for 15-30s during campaign surges, baseline ~2-5 rps.
- Latency target: tail p95 < 400ms for chat prompts under 1024 tokens. Throughput target: sustain short bursts with graceful degradation.
- Cost sensitivity: high — SMB pricing, want suggestions for token-level cost control + batching to reduce spend.
- Preference: hosted_api (no VPC) for quick onboarding; open to Dedicated later if burst SLAs can't be met.

Technical asks noted:
- Clear per-key quotas and burst windows (how many requests/second and token burst allowances)
- Concurrency limits: prefer client-visible headers with budget remaining; library guidance for exponential backoff + jitter, and sample client queue implementation.
- Graceful fallback options: smaller model fallback when concurrency throttled, or cached prefix responses for common prompts.
- Observability: per-route latency & token usage dashboard for their trial key; email alert for >10% 429 rate over 5m.

Decision signals: fast time-to-value, good docs + SDK examples, clear rate-limit UX and cost controls.

Stated blockers: need SOC2 report before billing, finance wants a short written SLA for burst behavior for the trial period.

AE notes / next actions: Rafael to draft a 1-page rate-limit playbook + sample client queuing snippet, attach SOC2 link & pricing, propose 30m POC to test a scripted marketing surge (seeded traffic) using trial key.
